source_doc: Military Exercise Soyuz-75 Combat Instruction No. 04 of the Maritime Front, 24 Mar 1975 (Molczyk, Antos; IPN; translated for CWIHP by G. Goldberg)
quote: the aircraft at the GRONINGEN and LEEUWARDEN airfields with two missiles with 40 kt and 100 kt [warheads]
notes: Exercise. English translation only, no scan read. Country from the place. Under 'Destroy [the following] with nuclear strikes'. Two missiles for the two airfields; which yield goes where is not stated.
